arguments.content:
# Tests for lib/strings.sh; run with sh tests/run.sh.
check "trim spaces" "a b" "$(trim '  a b  ')"
check "trim tabs" "x" "$(trim '	x	')"
check "trim empty" "" "$(trim '   ')"
check "upper" "HELLO WORLD 42" "$(upper 'hello World 42')"
check "repeat" "---" "$(repeat_char - 3)"
check "repeat once" "*" "$(repeat_char '*' 1)"
check "repeat none" "" "$(repeat_char x 0)"

events.text: Added checks for trim, upper and repeat_char, including tabs, empty input and zero counts.
